newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish up in very quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish up in very quiet trade.

text.p: April 18 - U.S. debt futures finished higher in very quiet trade, though June T-bond broke its 7 week string of lower weekly closes, to close higher on the week. Still, June stuck in Thursday's range. Resistance at 108-7/32 and 108-8/32 held. September Euro hit 3-week high, trade quiet there as well.
